#!/bin/bash
# Auto-commit and push changes to the AIBrain vault after every edit

cd /Users/brunobrunkow/Documents/AIBrain || exit 0

# Read stdin (Claude Code passes hook data as JSON on stdin)
INPUT=$(cat)
FILE_PATH=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null)

if [ -z "$FILE_PATH" ]; then
  exit 0
fi

# Stage the changed file
git add "$FILE_PATH" 2>/dev/null

# Only commit if there are staged changes
if ! git diff --cached --quiet 2>/dev/null; then
  FILENAME=$(basename "$FILE_PATH")
  git commit -m "vault: update $FILENAME" --no-gpg-sign 2>/dev/null
  git push 2>/dev/null || echo "$(date): push failed for $FILE_PATH" >> /tmp/aibrain-push.log
fi

exit 0
